architecture: AI-first platform governing the full 8-step lifecycle of data products — AI agents generate all artifacts at each step, humans review and approve only

Partial production support in progress since August 2026 — phased rollout ongoing

Generic platform design — reusable beyond the first ODP instance for any organisation's data products
